definition.pairing: one untrained checkpoint per cell; spread is across training seeds
definition.quantity: terminal PCMD minus untrained PCMD on the level's held-out split
definition.support_rule: a comparison is reportable when the untrained cell clears the 30-prompt support bar and the trained seeds pool to at least that many eligible prompts between them; per-seed counts are kept so a thin seed stays visible
definition.transfer_note: Every cell trains at Level 1. Level 1 is trained and evaluated together; Levels 2-5 read that same policy on constructions it never trained on, so they are transfer.
